newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha eases in a moribund market.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha eases in a moribund market.

text.p: NWE naphtha weakened slightly on Friday in line with crude futures and amid fairly healthy supplies, traders said.
June swaps were talked around $187.50/$188, while July paper was put around $187.75/$189.
Buyers and sellers were wide apart on cargo prices with bids/offers priced around $180/$186 a tonne cif NWE.
Many traders said a long-awaited pick up in demand slated for June had failed to materialise and that the market was looking a bit sloppy.
"There's plenty of material out there," said one trader.
